groups.saying_opens: إنا كنا نسلف على عهد رسول الله
إنا كنا نسلف على عهد رسول الله
إنا كنا نسلف على عهد رسول الله
وسألت ابن أبزى فقال مثل ذلك

notes: Four isnads in three forms: «وحدثنا يحيى» is a second isnad of the same saying, so the report splits into groups; branches 1 and 2 end where their own text ends (no convergence marker, so the Companion written after the third isnad is not added to them)
«أخبرني محمد، أو عبد الله بن أبي المجالد»: an «أو» alternative in one level; the same man as the earlier «ابن أبي المجالد» is not merged (rule 9)
Saying 2 («وسألت ابن أبزى فقال مثل ذلك») has its own transmitter, Ibn Abza, so it is its own group, sharing the head up to the narrator (rule 4a)
Ibn Abi Awfa is asked and answers (rule 5), so he is the last link of saying 1; the feuding of Abdullah b. Shaddad and Abu Burda is scene
